ns2:course.label: Cellular Metabolism in Animals
ns2:course.description: Principles and regulation of cellular metabolism in animals, emphasizing energy derivation and its relationship to domestic animal and food production. Prerequisite: CHEM 104, CHEM 105, and ANSC 221 or equivalent.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: CHEM 104, CHEM 105, and ANSC 221 or equivalent.
